shots.framing: Medium two-shot, both figures in frame, Maharaj on left, Pitambar on right, simple background suggesting temple surroundings.
shots.pose: Maharaj seated eating Zunka-Bhakri, Pitambar standing nearby listening attentively.

shots.framing: Close-up on Pitambar's face, neutral background, slow push in.
shots.pose: Pitambar close-up, face showing concern and hesitation, eyebrows slightly raised.

shots.framing: Medium shot on Maharaj, slow push in, background blurred.
shots.pose: Maharaj seated, one hand raised in firm instruction, calm authoritative expression.

shots.framing: Full body shot, stream in foreground, temple structures faint in background, slow push.
shots.pose: Pitambar standing at the edge of the shallow stream, looking down at the water, tumba held loosely at side.

shots.framing: Extreme close-up on hands and tumba, water surface filling frame.
shots.pose: Hands lowering a tumba into shallow water, fingertips touching the surface.

shots.framing: Low angle close to water, showing the hollow and submerged tumba, slow push.
shots.pose: Tumba fully submerged in a newly formed hollow in the stream bed, water rising around it.

shots.framing: Close-up on tumba, clear water visible, bright highlight.
shots.pose: Tumba held up, filled with crystal-clear water, light refracting through.

shots.framing: Extreme close-up, very slow push, soft halo effect.
shots.pose: Pitambar's face, eyes wide with wonder, a soft halo of realization.

shots.framing: Two-shot, Pitambar lower, Maharaj higher, slow push in.
shots.pose: Pitambar kneeling, offering the filled tumba to Maharaj who is seated finishing his meal.

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, slight low angle, neem tree background, warm afternoon light
shots.pose: Maharaj seated on left, Bankatlal standing on right facing Maharaj, Bankatlal's hand extended offering betel nut

shots.framing: Extreme close-up top-down view of hands, betel nut pieces visible
shots.pose: Bankatlal's hand cracking betel nut, Maharaj's open palm receiving pieces

shots.framing: Close-up of palm with coins, betel nut remnants aside
shots.pose: Bankatlal placing two copper coins (Vyaghrambari and Dudandi) on Maharaj's palm

shots.framing: Close-up, shallow depth of field, neem leaves blurred background
shots.pose: Maharaj smiling, eyes twinkling, head slightly tilted back in laughter

shots.framing: Tight close-up, soft halo effect, warm golden light
shots.pose: Maharaj serene, one hand raised in teaching gesture (vitarka mudra), gaze direct and compassionate

shots.framing: Wide shot, slow push in, neem tree canopy above, temple steps in distance
shots.pose: Maharaj seated under neem tree, Bankatlal and Pitambar walking away towards temple steps

shots.framing: Establishing shot, 4 layers (sky, mid, fx, fg), slow dolly 1.0->1.28
shots.pose: Wide view of Shiva Temple courtyard at dusk, people dispersing, Bankatlal walking toward home

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, gentle drift across figures
shots.pose: Bankatlal standing, hands folded, speaking to seated father Bhavaniram

shots.framing: Slow push with soft halo
shots.pose: Bankatlal close-up, eyes bright, smiling

shots.framing: Establishing shot, 4 layers, dolly
shots.pose: Wide view of Manik Chowk at sunset, Bankatlal waiting

shots.framing: Camera pans with Maharaj
shots.pose: Maharaj walking toward Bankatlal, Bankatlal standing with folded hands

shots.framing: Lateral parallax through depth layers (sky, far, mid, near)
shots.pose: Cows gathering around Maharaj, birds on trees, cowherd nearby

shots.framing: Establishing shot of house entrance at twilight, 4 layers
shots.pose: Bankatlal and Maharaj approaching house, shopkeepers lighting lamps

shots.framing: Close-up on Maharaj's upper body, showing adornments
shots.pose: Maharaj seated, adorned with saffron paste on forehead, garlands around neck, tulsi blossoms on head

shots.framing: Medium shot of offerings being arranged on a platter in front of Maharaj
shots.pose: Devotees placing various food offerings (naivedya) before Maharaj

shots.framing: Establishing shot of the house exterior, soft morning light
shots.pose: Wide view of Bankatlal's house transformed into Dwarka, with a sign or atmosphere indicating Monday, Shiva's day

shots.framing: Group shot showing contrast between satisfied devotees and Ichharam
shots.pose: Group of devotees (mandali) looking fulfilled, Ichharam Shetji standing apart with unresolved expression

shots.framing: Close-up on Ichharam's face, thoughtful gaze
shots.pose: Ichharam Shetji, cousin of Bankatlal, devout, thinking

shots.framing: Close-up on Ichharam, slight upward gaze
shots.pose: Ichharam with hands folded, internal thought: 'Today is Monday, my fast; Shankar himself has come walking into Bankatlal's house'

shots.framing: Medium shot of Ichharam in a determined pose, perhaps hands in prayer
shots.pose: Ichharam resolving to worship Maharaj after sunset, then break fast

shots.framing: Wide shot of Ichharam bathing in a courtyard or river, twilight
shots.pose: Ichharam bathing at sunset, Pradosh hour, water poured over him

shots.framing: Close-up on Ichharam's hands performing puja, Maharaj receiving
shots.pose: Ichharam performing puja with worship materials, offering to Maharaj with supreme love

shots.framing: Establishing environmental parallax showing three pilgrimage sites layered in depth, conveying massive crowds.
shots.pose: Wide lateral move through pilgrimage sites: Pandharpur temple far, Godavari river mid, Haridwar ghats near, sky above.

shots.framing: Wide establishing shot of Shegaon, showing the house becoming a temple, crowds gathering.
shots.pose: Shegaon town bustling, Bankatlal's house transforming into a temple (Raula), with devotees arriving.

shots.framing: Slow push on a symbolic image of the sun illuminating all beings equally.
shots.pose: Sun radiating light equally over diverse figures, symbolizing caste transcendence.

shots.framing: Lateral move through layers of devotees and feast preparations.
shots.pose: Crowds of pilgrims arriving at Shegaon, communal feast (mahaprasad) being served.

shots.framing: Close-up symbolic representation of author's humility.

need_new.reason: No preset for symbolic representation of author's humility (insect metaphor) and inability to describe routine; requires custom illustration.

shots.pose: Dasganu as a tiny insect before Maharaj's vast form, or a humble devotee with folded hands.

shots.framing: Environmental parallax showing the trough, bath, and muddy water in layers.
shots.pose: Maharaj at cattle watering trough (hal), taking auspicious bath with 100 pots, drinking muddy water; wind-like unpredictability.

shots.framing: Full-frame insert of chilim being lit, emphasizing outward play without attachment.
shots.pose: Close-up of hands lighting a chilim (clay pipe), smoke rising.

shots.framing: Slow tilt down onto folded hands, symbolizing invitation and phalashruti.
shots.pose: Folded hands in prayer (pranam), tilting down onto contact point.
